Food & Beverage

Fresh, Local, and Flavorful — Taste the Essence of Bali at Omer Villa & Retreat.

 

At Omer Villa & Retreat, we believe that great food begins with the finest ingredients. Our menu is crafted with love, featuring healthy, homemade dishes made from locally sourced produce. Whether you’re enjoying a vibrant breakfast, a light lunch, or a hearty dinner, you’ll savor the freshness and flavor of every bite. From tropical fruits to organic vegetables and free-range meats, we prioritize sustainability and support local farmers to bring you meals that are as nourishing as they are delicious.

In addition to our private chef service, we also offer in-villa dining and accept food catering for special events, ensuring that every meal is tailored to your group’s preferences. Enjoy the best of Western and Indonesian cuisine without ever leaving the comfort of your villa.

Whether you’re practicing sun salutations at dawn or unwinding with an evening meditation, the calming energy of the landscape enhances every experience.

Our peaceful surroundings offer an ideal atmosphere to host yoga retreats, wellness workshops, or healing events. The open-air spaces invite fresh breezes and natural light, creating a supportive environment that encourages relaxation, reflection, and connection with the self. Family & Groups

Create Unforgettable Memories – Your Family’s Escape Awaits at Omer Villa & Retreat

 

Omer Villa & Retreat is a family-friendly and group accommodation nestled between Canggu and Ubud, offering a peaceful escape in the heart of Bali. Surrounded by lush rice fields, the villa provides a spacious and serene setting ideal for families, friends, or groups seeking a private retreat.

Designed with comfort and eco-friendly living in mind, Omer Villa offers ample space for both relaxation and recreation. Kids can enjoy exploring the garden or playing in the outdoor areas, while adults unwind by the pool or take in the tranquil views. With its close proximity to the beaches of Canggu and the cultural richness of Ubud, Omer Villa is the perfect base for exploring Bali’s vibrant landscapes, whether you’re surfing, sightseeing, or simply relaxing as a family.

With multiple bedrooms, large common areas, and plenty of outdoor space, Omer Villa & Retreat is well-suited for gatherings, reunions, or group vacations, making it a versatile choice for those seeking a blend of comfort, nature, and adventure.
